brief: Holds what an agent knows as facts in its own knowledge graph, each one carrying where and when it was learned.
detail: A memory owns a stzKnowledgeGraph, named mem-<agent>, rather than being one: it gives the agent a thin face of subject, predicate, object triples. Text is folded to lower case on the way in, so Fact and Recall ignore case. Every fact records its source (agent:<name> unless the caller says otherwise) and the time learned; nothing invents a confidence. Save and Restore carry the facts and their provenance through a .zknw knowledge file. Restore must be given the full file name with the extension.
